method.method: Exhaustive graph with dependency-closed refresh of cached decisions; all distances must be recomputed
method.scope: All legal KBNvK starts, both sides, both bishop colors, counters reset. All selected White ties.

buckets.label: Winning, but policy does not force mate

classification.scope: All legal KBNvK placements, both turns, fresh clock, including Syzygy draws (reported separately). Every current selected White tie and every legal Black reply. Cycles/captures/stalemates count as no forced mate. Symmetry classes weighted by actual orbit size.
